purpose: Validate that the reusable Leverage business engine can plan a non-Gumroad project type without launching or spending.

scenarios.example_offer: Small operations dashboard for a narrowly defined business workflow

validation_rules: Project type must resolve from the project-type registry.
Channel must be valid for the selected project type.
Delivery mechanism must be valid for the selected project type.
Revenue events must be valid for the selected project type.
Dry runs cannot publish, spend money, create binding commitments, or change live projects.
